verdict.rationale: Netlify documents a first-party REST API for managing sites, deploys, DNS "and more" programmatically, plus an official CLI, so a real API surface exists. Nothing in the evidence shows the API matches everything the UI can do, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. missing for 10: evidence of explicit API/UI parity, a published machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI), API coverage of dashboard features such as security, analytics, collaborative previews and the AI agent features, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Manage sites, deploys, DNS, and more programmatically with the Netlify REST API—ideal for automating workflows and integrating into your systems.
Deploy sites, run local dev servers, and manage your Netlify projects right from the terminal with this powerful command-line tool.
